Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    o=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==1]
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=ones[0],twos[0]
    def sgn(x): return (x>0)-(x<0)
    d1=(sgn(r2-r1),sgn(c2-c1))
    a2=(r2+d1[0],c2+d1[1])      # one step from 2 ALONG 1's ray direction (not -d1!)
    rr,cc=r1+d1[0],c1+d1[1]; inter=None
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
        if rr==a2[0] or cc==a2[1]:
            inter=(rr,cc); break
        rr+=d1[0]; cc+=d1[1]
    if inter is None: return None
    p=inter
    if p[1]==a2[1]:
        seg=[(r,a2[1]) for r in range(min(p[0],a2[0]),max(p[0],a2[0])+1)]
    else:
        seg=[(a2[0],c) for c in range(min(p[1],a2[1]),max(p[1],a2[1])+1)]
    for q_ in seg:
        if 0<=q_[0]<H and 0<=q_[1]<W: o[q_[0]][q_[1]]=3
    k=1
    while True:
        q_=(r1+k*d1[0],c1+k*d1[1])
        if not(0<=q_[0]<H and 0<=q_[1]<W): break
        if any(q_==q2 for q2 in seg): break
        o[q_[0]][q_[1]]=3
        k+=1
    return o

for p in [1,2]:
    ok=solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p,'match:',ok)
    if not ok:
        A=[(r,c) for r in range(len(solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']))) for c in range(len(solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])[0])) if solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])[r][c]]
        B=[(r,c) for r in range(len(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])) for c in range(len(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'][0])) if G[f'Demo pair {p} output'][r][c]]
        print(' pred',A); print(' act ',B)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def f(a):
    n=len(a)
    one=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if a[r][c]==1][0]
    two=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if a[r][c]==2][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in a]
    dr=(two[0]-one[0])//max(abs(two[0]-one[0]),1)
    dc=(two[1]-one[1])//max(abs(two[1]-one[1]),1)
    p=(one[0]+dr,one[1]+dc)
    diag=[]
    # march; stop when p adjacent (chebyshev) to two's row or col
    while p==(two[0],two[1]) or True:
        adj_r = abs(p[0]-two[0])==1 and abs(p[1]-two[1])==1 or False
        # stop when |pr-r2|==1 or |pc-c2|==1 (moving toward two), but not onto two
        stop = (abs(p[0]-two[0])==1 and dr*(p[0]-two[0])<0 and p[0]!=two[0] and p[1]!=two[1]) \
             or (abs(p[1]-two[1])==1 and dc*(p[1]-two[1])<0 and p[1]!=two[1] and p[0]!=two[0])
        if p==(two[0],two[1]): break
        diag.append(p)
        nr,nc=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
        if nr<0 or nr>=n or nc<0 or nc>=n or (nr,nc)==(two[0],two[1]): break
        p=(nr,nc)
    # bar: perpendicular at stop cell
    rs,cs=diag[-1]
    if abs(rs-two[0])==1:   # row stop -> horizontal bar
        step=0 if cs==two[1] else (1 if two[1]>cs else -1)
        c=cs+step
        while 0<=c<n and abs(c-two[1])==2 or (abs(c-two[1])==1 and abs(rs-two[0])==1 and rs!=two[0]):
            break
        # simpler: extend to cell diagonally adjacent to two: col c2-1 or c2+1
        if two[1]>cs: cl=two[1]-1
        else: cl=two[1]+1
        while c!=cl:
            out[rs][c]=3; c+=step
        out[rs][cs]=3
    else:                   # col stop -> vertical bar
        step=1 if two[0]>rs else -1
        r=rs+step
        if two[0]>rs: rl=two[0]-1
        else: rl=two[0]+1
        while r!=rl:
            out[r][cs]=3; r+=step
        out[rs][cs]=3
    return out

def solve(a):
    H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    o=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r][c]==1][0]
    t=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r][c]==2][0]
    b=[row[:] for row in a]
    tr,tc=t
    # diagonal toward two, stepping until the NEXT cell would hit two's row or column
    dr = 1 if tr>o[0] else -1
    dc = 1 if tc>o[1] else -1
    r,c=o
    while True:
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        if nr==tr or nc==tc: break
        r,c=nr,nc
        b[r][c]=3
    # perpendicular leg: step perpendicular, staying away from two's row/col, toward two
    # directions: pick one that moves toward two in the non-diagonal axis
    dirs=[]
    if tc>r: dirs.append((0,1))   # move right if two is to the right-ish
    else: dirs.append((0,-1))
    if tr>c: dirs.append((1,0))
    else: dirs.append((-1,0))
    # choose dir whose first step doesn't immediately touch two's row/col and stays bounded
    dd=None
    for d in dirs:
        rr,rc_=r+d[0],c+d[1]
        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=rc_<W and rr!=tr and rc_!=tc:
            dd=d; break
    if dd is None:
        for d in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
            rr,rc_=r+d[0],c+d[1]
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=rc_<W and rr!=tr and rc_!=tc:
                dd=d; break
    while True:
        nr,nc=r+dd[0],c+dd[1]
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or nr==tr or nc==tc: break
        r,c=nr,nc
        b[r][c]=3
    return b
